source_book: The Brand Relationship Spectrum — Aaker & Joachimsthaler (2000)

test_cases.prompt: We want to endorse this new brand with the parent so it gets credibility but stays independent.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands; pick shadow/token/linked/strong and verify endorser equity.

test_cases.prompt: Add 'a [Parent] company' tagline / logo to the product without making the parent the hero.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands; implement a token endorser with consistent visual system.

test_cases.prompt: We want a linked name like Egg McMuffin so it implies the parent without a formal endorsement.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands; design a linked name that borrows the parent's communication task.

test_cases.prompt: Attach a subbrand that shares the driver role with the master, like Gillette Mach3.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands; activate aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver (major driver role, not minor).

test_cases.prompt: Keep the brands totally separate with no link to the parent at all.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands; activate aaker-relation-house-of-brands (no link).

test_cases.prompt: We want a token endorser but the parent is weak and unknown in this market.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate aaker-relation-endorsed-brands but strongly caution: a weak/unknown token endorser adds little (Providian/Nescafé-in-US lessons); may not be worth it.
test_cases.notes: Boundary: token endorser only works with known/consistent/well-regarded endorser.

notes: ≥3 should_trigger + 2 should_not_trigger (sibling baits: aaker-relation-subbrand-codriver, aaker-relation-house-of-brands) + 1 edge.
